reviews.comment:
Buena atención, funciona el ACA y tiene servicio de Box para cambios de aceite, filtros, sin lavadero, pero con una amplia cafetería,góndolas y heladeras para llevar comida rápida, respetan bien el protocolo Covid, disponen de mesas afuera para la cafetería, y baños le ponemos un 7,50, además cuenta con vertedor de agua caliente, podes hacerte socio del ACA ahí, atienden de 9 a 16,30 hs de lunes a viernes, si sos viajero no  lo dudes.

(Translated by Google)
Good service, the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) is open and has a service bay for oil and filter changes. There's no car wash, but it has a large cafeteria, gondolas and refrigerators for takeaway food, they follow the Covid protocol well, they have tables outside for the cafeteria, and the restrooms are clean. We give it a 7.5 out of 10. It also has a hot water dispenser, you can become an ACA member there, they are open from 9 am to 4:30 pm Monday to Friday. If you're a traveler, don't hesitate.

El Boxes es una estafa. Te cobran los filtros carísimos, no te reconocen las promociones, no te suman puntos serviclub, no te dejan pagar en cuotas con tarjeta y la mano de obra es polémica, le cargaron 7 litros de aceite cuando el manual y cambios anteriores siempre cargo 8. NUNCA LLEVEN EL VEHÍCULO ACÁ.

(Translated by Google)
Boxes is a scam. They charge exorbitant prices for filters, don't honor promotions, don't award Serviclub points, don't allow payment in installments with a credit card, and their labor is questionable. They put in 7 liters of oil when the manual and previous changes always called for 8. NEVER TAKE YOUR VEHICLE HERE.
